articles.title: Could poo be used to make concrete in the future?
Scientists Are Making Concrete With Human Poop – And It Gets 42% Stronger

Researchers took biochar made from human waste at a treatment plant in Warangal, India, ground it into a fine black powder and mixed it into concrete in place of a tenth of the cement. After 91 days the concrete was 21 percent harder to crush.
